statements.impact_statement: Agent Studio imports only InvalidTag and AESGCM for tenant-scoped MCP credential encryption. It does not import or invoke pkcs7_decrypt_der, pkcs7_decrypt_pem, pkcs7_decrypt_smime, or any PKCS#7 decryption API required to expose CVE-2026-69247. The security regression test fails if a new cryptography import or PKCS#7 reference is added under src/.
